profile.name: Parth Biyani
profile.summary: Computer Engineering undergraduate at Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (2023–2027) with hands-on experience across three tracks: backend/software engineering (FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, JWT/RBAC, microservices), applied ML and agentic AI (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain/LangGraph, RAG, vector search with Qdrant, LLM evaluation), and data analytics/BI (Power BI, DAX, ETL pipelines, SQL, statistical modeling). Shipped freelance work in production use — a Flutter/MongoDB academy platform serving 100+ students and an inventory system processing 10,000+ stock entries/day — plus independent projects spanning agentic RAG systems, a speech-to-text/TTS research copilot, and neural network compression research. Co-authored a paper accepted at IEEE ICSIT 2026 and led a 7-member team to a top-3 global finish at the VFS Student Design Challenge sponsored by Airbus. Looking for software engineering, ML/AI, or data engineering/analytics internships and full-time roles at product-focused tech companies, ideally working close to the backend/ML boundary.
projects: ProjectMind — agentic memory platform indexing 100+ project artifacts into a hybrid semantic + keyword search layer (LangGraph, RAG, Qdrant, FastAPI)
VoiceBrief — multilingual (Hindi/English) knowledge-to-speech copilot converting research papers into short audio briefs (LangGraph, Whisper, TTS, Qdrant)
Self-Pruning Neural Network — CNN with learnable gate parameters for training-time pruning; compressed 70% of weights within 0.3% of baseline CIFAR-10 accuracy (PyTorch, model compression)
CivicPulse — crowdsourced grievance redressal app with RBAC auth and a state-machine complaint lifecycle (Flutter, FastAPI, Node.js, OpenCV)
Data Jobs Market Dashboard — Power BI dashboard over a global job-market dataset with DAX measures, drill-through and geospatial salary/skill-demand analysis (Power BI, Power Query, DAX, ETL)
